    67	def validate_inputs(x):
    68	    """Validate the common rank-major array and return (P,R,D)."""
    69	    if not isinstance(x, list):
    70	        schema()
    71	    p = len(x)
    72	    if p < 1 or p > 8:
    73	        limit()
    74	    if not all(isinstance(row, list) for row in x):
    75	        schema()
    76	    rcount = len(x[0])
    77	    if rcount > 128:
    78	        limit()
    79	    if any(len(row) != rcount for row in x):
    80	        schema()
    81	    if rcount == 0:
    82	        # D is defined to be zero in this case.
    83	        return p, 0, 0
    84	    if not all(isinstance(v, list) for row in x for v in row):
    85	        schema()
    86	    d = len(x[0][0])
    87	    if d > 32:
    88	        limit()
    89	    for row in x:
    90	        for vec in row:
    91	            if len(vec) != d:
    92	                schema()
    93	            for z in vec:
    94	                integer(z, INPUT_MIN, INPUT_MAX)
    95	    return p, rcount, d

    98	def expected_results(inputs, p, rcount, d):
    99	    ans = [[0] * d for _ in range(rcount)]
   100	    for r in range(p):
   101	        row = inputs[r]
   102	        for q in range(rcount):
   103	            src = row[q]
   104	            dst = ans[q]
   105	            for k in range(d):
   106	                dst[k] += src[k]
   107	    return ans

   110	def validate_replay(obj):
   111	    exact_object(obj, ("op", "inputs", "slots", "window", "events"))
   112	    p, rcount, d = validate_inputs(obj["inputs"])
   113	    slots = integer(obj["slots"], 1, 16)
   114	    window = integer(obj["window"], 1, slots)
   115	    events = obj["events"]
   116	    if not isinstance(events, list):
   117	        schema()
   118	    if len(events) > 20000:
   119	        limit()
   120	    # Validate the complete event list before doing any stateful processing.
   121	    for ev in events:
   122	        if not isinstance(ev, list) or not ev:
   123	            schema()
   124	        kind = ev[0]
   125	        if not isinstance(kind, str):
   126	            schema()
   127	        if kind == "send":
   128	            if len(ev) != 3:
   129	                schema()
   130	            integer(ev[1], 0, p - 1)
   131	            integer(ev[2], 0, rcount - 1)
   132	        elif kind == "retry":
   133	            if len(ev) != 2:
   134	                schema()
   135	            integer(ev[1], 0, p - 1)
   136	        elif kind == "deliver" or kind == "drop" or kind == "duplicate":
   137	            if len(ev) != 2:
   138	                schema()
   139	            integer(ev[1], 0, 200000)
   140	        else:
   141	            schema()
   142	    return p, rcount, d, slots, window, events

   145	def replay(obj):
   146	    p, rcount, d, slot_count, window, events = validate_replay(obj)
   147	    inputs = obj["inputs"]
   148	
   149	    sent = [0] * p
   150	    received = [[] for _ in range(p)]
   151	    up_next = [0] * p
   152	    acked = [0] * p
   153	    floor = 0
   154	    # Each item is [absolute sequence, set of ranks, vector sum], or None.
   155	    buf = [None] * slot_count
   156	    pending = {}
   157	    next_id = 0
   158	    event_answer = []
   159	
   160	    def create(kind, rank, seq, value):
   161	        nonlocal next_id
   162	        if next_id >= 200000:
   163	            limit()
   164	        pid = next_id
   165	        next_id += 1
   166	        # Copies at creation make the immutability of packets explicit.  No
   167	        # operation mutates a packet value afterwards.
   168	        if value is not None:
   169	            value = list(value)
   170	        pending[pid] = [pid, kind, rank, seq, value]
   171	        if len(pending) > 2048:
   172	            limit()
   173	        return pid
   174	
   175	    for ev in events:
   176	        kind = ev[0]
   177	        made = []
   178	        if kind == "send":
   179	            rank, q = ev[1], ev[2]
   180	            if not (sent[rank] <= q < min(rcount, sent[rank] + window)):
   181	                event_answer.append({"status": "disabled", "created": []})
   182	                continue
   183	            made.append(create("up", rank, q, inputs[rank][q]))
   184	        elif kind == "retry":
   185	            rank = ev[1]
   186	            full = []
   187	            for ent in buf:
   188	                if ent is not None and len(ent[1]) == p and ent[0] >= acked[rank]:
   189	                    full.append(ent)
   190	            full.sort(key=lambda ent: ent[0])
   191	            for ent in full:
   192	                made.append(create("down", rank, ent[0], ent[2]))
   193	        else:
   194	            pid = ev[1]
   195	            packet = pending.get(pid)
   196	            if packet is None:
   197	                event_answer.append({"status": "missing", "created": []})
   198	                continue
   199	            if kind == "duplicate":
   200	                # Duplication retains the original packet.
   201	                made.append(create(packet[1], packet[2], packet[3], packet[4]))
   202	            else:
   203	                # Both delivery and drop remove the original before any
   204	                # resulting packets are made.
   205	                del pending[pid]
   206	                if kind == "drop":
   207	                    pass
   208	                else:
   209	                    _, pkind, rank, seq, value = packet
   210	                    if pkind == "up":
   211	                        q = seq
   212	                        became_full = False
   213	                        ent = None
   214	                        if floor <= q < floor + slot_count:
   215	                            ix = q % slot_count
   216	                            ent = buf[ix]
   217	                            if ent is None:
   218	                                ent = [q, set(), [0] * d]
   219	                                buf[ix] = ent
   220	                            # Valid replay states have at most one tag per
   221	                            # physical slot.  The tag check is important for
   222	                            # old packets after reuse.
   223	                            if ent[0] != q:
   224	                                # This cannot arise from the specified
   225	                                # transition relation; retaining the old tag
   226	                                # is safer than ever aliasing a contribution.
   227	                                ent = None
   228	                            else:
   229	                                was_full = len(ent[1]) == p
   230	                                if rank not in ent[1]:
   231	                                    ent[1].add(rank)
   232	                                    src = value
   233	                                    dst = ent[2]
   234	                                    for k in range(d):
   235	                                        dst[k] += src[k]
   236	                                became_full = (not was_full) and len(ent[1]) == p
   237	                            # Advance only through entries carrying this
   238	                            # rank, using absolute tags rather than just the
   239	                            # physical index.
   240	                            while True:
   240	                            while True:
   241	                                nq = up_next[rank]
   242	                                e2 = buf[nq % slot_count]
   243	                                if e2 is None or e2[0] != nq or rank not in e2[1]:
   244	                                    break
   245	                                up_next[rank] = nq + 1
   246	                        made.append(create("uack", rank, up_next[rank], None))
   247	                        if became_full:
   248	                            for dst_rank in range(p):
   249	                                made.append(create("down", dst_rank, ent[0], ent[2]))
   250	                    elif pkind == "uack":
   251	                        if seq > sent[rank]:
   252	                            sent[rank] = seq
   253	                    elif pkind == "down":
   254	                        if seq == len(received[rank]):
   255	                            received[rank].append(list(value))
   256	                        made.append(create("dack", rank, len(received[rank]), None))
   257	                    else:  # dack
   258	                        if seq > acked[rank]:
   259	                            acked[rank] = seq
   260	                        new_floor = min(acked)
   261	                        floor = new_floor
   262	                        if new_floor:
   263	                            for ix, ent in enumerate(buf):
   264	                                if ent is not None and ent[0] < new_floor:
   265	                                    buf[ix] = None
   266	        event_answer.append({"status": "ok", "created": made})
   267	
   268	    hosts = [{"sent": sent[r], "received": received[r]} for r in range(p)]
   269	    slot_answer = []
   270	    for ent in sorted((e for e in buf if e is not None), key=lambda e: e[0]):
   271	        slot_answer.append({"seq": ent[0], "ranks": sorted(ent[1]), "sum": ent[2]})
   272	    packet_answer = []
   273	    for pid in sorted(pending):
   274	        _, pkind, rank, seq, value = pending[pid]
   275	        packet_answer.append({"id": pid, "kind": pkind, "rank": rank,
   276	                              "seq": seq, "value": value})
   277	    return {"hosts": hosts, "floor": floor, "slots": slot_answer,
   278	            "packets": packet_answer, "events": event_answer}

   281	def validate_graph(obj):
   282	    exact_object(obj, ("op", "inputs", "states", "edges", "start", "fairness"))
   283	    inputs = obj["inputs"]
   284	    p, rcount, d = validate_inputs(inputs)
   285	    states = obj["states"]
   286	    edges = obj["edges"]
   287	    fairness = obj["fairness"]
   288	    if not isinstance(states, list):
   289	        schema()
   290	    if len(states) < 1 or len(states) > 12000:
   291	        limit()
   292	    if not isinstance(edges, list):
   293	        schema()
   294	    if len(edges) > 60000:
   295	        limit()
   296	    if not isinstance(fairness, list):
   297	        schema()
   298	    if len(fairness) > 16:
   299	        limit()
   300	    start = integer(obj["start"], 0, len(states) - 1)
   301	
   302	    expected = expected_results(inputs, p, rcount, d)
   303	    safe_nodes = []
   304	    done_nodes = []
   305	    for st in states:
   306	        exact_object(st, ("delivered", "slots"))
   307	        delivered = st["delivered"]
   308	        if not isinstance(delivered, list) or len(delivered) != p:
   309	            schema()
   310	        is_done = True
   311	        is_safe = True
   312	        for r in range(p):
   313	            dl = delivered[r]
   314	            if not isinstance(dl, list):
   315	                schema()
   316	            if len(dl) > rcount:
   317	                limit()
   318	            if len(dl) != rcount:
   319	                is_done = False
   320	            for q, vec in enumerate(dl):
   321	                if not isinstance(vec, list) or len(vec) != d:
   322	                    schema()
   323	                for z in vec:
   324	                    integer(z, SNAP_MIN, SNAP_MAX)
   325	                if vec != expected[q]:
   326	                    is_safe = False
   327	        slots = st["slots"]
   328	        if not isinstance(slots, list):
   329	            schema()
   330	        if len(slots) > 16:
   331	            limit()
   332	        seen_seq = set()
   333	        for sl in slots:
   334	            exact_object(sl, ("seq", "ranks", "sum"))
   335	            q = integer(sl["seq"], 0, rcount - 1)
   336	            if q in seen_seq:
   337	                schema()
   338	            seen_seq.add(q)
   339	            ranks = sl["ranks"]
   340	            if not isinstance(ranks, list):
   341	                schema()
   342	            if len(ranks) > p:
   343	                # With valid unique rank indices this is also a collection
   344	                # bound; duplicate entries are diagnosed below as schema.
   345	                # Do not reject before checking the entries.
   346	                pass
   347	            seen_ranks = set()
   348	            for r in ranks:
   349	                integer(r, 0, p - 1)
   350	                if r in seen_ranks:
   351	                    schema()
   352	                seen_ranks.add(r)
   353	            if len(ranks) > p:
   354	                limit()
   355	            vec = sl["sum"]
   356	            if not isinstance(vec, list) or len(vec) != d:
   357	                schema()
   358	            for z in vec:
   359	                integer(z, SNAP_MIN, SNAP_MAX)
   360	            want = [0] * d
   361	            for r in ranks:
   362	                src = inputs[r][q]
   363	                for k in range(d):
   364	                    want[k] += src[k]
   365	            if vec != want:
   366	                is_safe = False
   367	        safe_nodes.append(is_safe)
   368	        done_nodes.append(is_done)
   369	
   370	    # Names are collected before assigning their export indices.
   371	    all_names = set()
   372	    parsed_edges = []
   373	    triples = set()
   374	    for eid, edge in enumerate(edges):
   375	        if not isinstance(edge, list) or len(edge) != 3:
   376	            schema()
   377	        s = integer(edge[0], 0, len(states) - 1)
   378	        a = name(edge[1])
   379	        t = integer(edge[2], 0, len(states) - 1)
   380	        triple = (s, a, t)
   381	        if triple in triples:
   382	            schema()
   383	        triples.add(triple)
   384	        all_names.add(a)
   385	        parsed_edges.append((s, a, t))
   386	    parsed_fair = []
   387	    fair_names = set()
   388	    for f in fairness:
   389	        exact_object(f, ("action", "mode"))
   390	        a = name(f["action"])
   391	        mode = f["mode"]
   392	        if not isinstance(mode, str) or mode not in ("weak", "strong"):
   393	            schema()
   394	        if a in fair_names:
   395	            schema()
   396	        fair_names.add(a)
   397	        all_names.add(a)
   398	        parsed_fair.append((a, mode))
   399	    if len(all_names) > 64:
   400	        limit()
   401	
   402	    names = sorted(all_names)
   403	    action_ids = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(names)}
   404	    n = len(states)
   405	    out = [[] for _ in range(n)]
   406	    rev = [[] for _ in range(n)]
   407	    edge_rows = []
   408	    for eid, (s, a, t) in enumerate(parsed_edges):
   409	        ai = action_ids[a]
   410	        edge_rows.append((s, ai, t))
   411	        out[s].append((t, ai, eid))
   412	        rev[t].append((s, ai, eid))
   413	    fair_ids = [(action_ids[a], mode) for a, mode in parsed_fair]
   414	    return {
   415	        "inputs": inputs, "p": p, "r": rcount, "d": d,
   416	        "states": states, "n": n, "start": start,
   417	        "safe_nodes": safe_nodes, "done_nodes": done_nodes,
   418	        "names": names, "action_ids": action_ids,
   419	        "edges": edge_rows, "out": out, "rev": rev,
   420	        "fairness": fair_ids,
   421	    }

   424	def reconstruct(target, start, parent, parent_edge):
   425	    ans = []
   426	    while target != start:
   427	        ans.append(parent_edge[target])
   428	        target = parent[target]
   429	    ans.reverse()
   430	    return ans

   433	def reachable_parents(start, out, forbidden=None):
   434	    n = len(out)
   435	    parent = [-2] * n
   436	    parent_edge = [-1] * n
   437	    if forbidden is not None and forbidden[start]:
   438	        return parent, parent_edge
   439	    parent[start] = -1
   440	    queue = deque([start])
   441	    while queue:
   442	        v = queue.popleft()
   443	        for t, _a, eid in out[v]:
   444	            if parent[t] == -2 and (forbidden is None or not forbidden[t]):
   445	                parent[t] = v
   446	                parent_edge[t] = eid
   447	                queue.append(t)
   448	    return parent, parent_edge

   451	def strongly_connected(vertices, out, rev, enabled, fair_bits, all_fair):
   452	    """Iterative Kosaraju, plus fairness summaries for every component.
   453	
   454	    A result item is (vertices, internal_edge_mask, enabled_mask,
   455	    disabled_mask).  The masks concern declared fairness actions only.
   456	    """
   457	    allowed = set(vertices)
   458	    seen = set()
   459	    order = []
   460	    for root in vertices:
   461	        if root in seen:
   462	            continue
   463	        seen.add(root)
   464	        stack = [(root, 0)]
   465	        while stack:
   466	            v, ix = stack[-1]
   467	            av = out[v]
   468	            if ix < len(av):
   469	                t = av[ix][0]
   470	                stack[-1] = (v, ix + 1)
   471	                if t in allowed and t not in seen:
   472	                    seen.add(t)
   473	                    stack.append((t, 0))
   474	            else:
   475	                order.append(v)
   476	                stack.pop()
   477	
   478	    which = {}
   479	    components = []
   480	    for root in reversed(order):
   481	        if root in which:
   482	            continue
   483	        cid = len(components)
   484	        which[root] = cid
   485	        vs = []
   486	        stack = [root]
   487	        while stack:
   488	            v = stack.pop()
   489	            vs.append(v)
   490	            for u, _a, _eid in rev[v]:
   491	                if u in allowed and u not in which:
   492	                    which[u] = cid
   493	                    stack.append(u)
   494	        components.append(vs)
   495	
   496	    nc = len(components)
   497	    edge_masks = [0] * nc
   498	    enabled_masks = [0] * nc
   499	    disabled_masks = [0] * nc
   500	    for v in vertices:
   501	        cid = which[v]
   502	        ev = enabled[v]
   503	        enabled_masks[cid] |= ev
   504	        disabled_masks[cid] |= all_fair & ~ev
   505	        for t, a, _eid in out[v]:
   506	            if which.get(t) == cid:
   507	                edge_masks[cid] |= fair_bits[a]
   508	    return [(components[i], edge_masks[i], enabled_masks[i], disabled_masks[i])
   509	            for i in range(nc)]

   512	def fair_witness(root_comp, out, rev, enabled, fair_bits, weak_mask,
   513	                 strong_mask, all_fair, prefix_parent, prefix_edge, start):
   514	    """Build a closed walk covering all fairness witnesses in an SCC."""
   515	    vs, edge_mask, _enabled_or, _disabled = root_comp
   516	    comp_set = set(vs)
   517	    root = vs[0]
   518	
   519	    # An internal edge is the occurrence witness for every declared action
   520	    # which has one.  A weak action without such an edge needs a disabled
   520	    # which has one.  A weak action without such an edge needs a disabled
   521	    # state instead.  Strong actions without an internal edge have no enabled
   522	    # state in a candidate component.
   523	    need_edges = edge_mask & all_fair
   524	    need_vertices = weak_mask & ~edge_mask
   525	    edge_witness = {}
   526	    vertex_witness = {}
   527	    for v in vs:
   528	        missing = need_vertices & ~enabled[v]
   529	        while missing:
   530	            bit = missing & -missing
   531	            vertex_witness[bit] = v
   532	            missing ^= bit
   533	        for t, a, eid in out[v]:
   534	            bit = fair_bits[a]
   535	            if bit and (bit & need_edges) and bit not in edge_witness and t in comp_set:
   536	                edge_witness[bit] = (v, t, eid)
   537	
   538	    # Trees from and to the root let us include each witness without an
   539	    # O(VE) closed-walk construction.  There are at most sixteen witnesses.
   540	    parent = {root: -1}
   541	    parent_e = {}
   542	    queue = deque([root])
   543	    while queue:
   544	        v = queue.popleft()
   545	        for t, _a, eid in out[v]:
   546	            if t in comp_set and t not in parent:
   547	                parent[t] = v
   548	                parent_e[t] = eid
   549	                queue.append(t)
   550	    next_node = {root: -1}
   551	    next_e = {}
   552	    queue = deque([root])
   553	    while queue:
   554	        v = queue.popleft()
   555	        for u, _a, eid in rev[v]:
   556	            if u in comp_set and u not in next_node:
   557	                next_node[u] = v
   558	                next_e[u] = eid
   559	                queue.append(u)
   560	
   561	    def from_root(v):
   562	        ids = []
   563	        while v != root:
   564	            ids.append(parent_e[v])
   565	            v = parent[v]
   566	        ids.reverse()
   567	        return ids
   568	
   569	    def to_root(v):
   570	        ids = []
   571	        while v != root:
   572	            ids.append(next_e[v])
   573	            v = next_node[v]
   574	        return ids
   575	
   576	    loop = []
   577	    # Sorting by bit is immaterial semantically and makes output stable.
   578	    for bit in sorted(edge_witness):
   579	        u, v, eid = edge_witness[bit]
   580	        loop.extend(from_root(u))
   581	        loop.append(eid)
   582	        loop.extend(to_root(v))
   583	    for bit in sorted(vertex_witness):
   584	        v = vertex_witness[bit]
   585	        loop.extend(from_root(v))
   586	        loop.extend(to_root(v))
   587	    if not loop:
   588	        # This is exactly the case where an implicit stutter at the root is a
   589	        # fair nonempty cycle (all needed weak witnesses, if any, are at the
   590	        # root and no strong action needs an occurrence).
   591	        loop = [-1]
   592	    prefix = reconstruct(root, start, prefix_parent, prefix_edge)
   593	    return {"prefix": prefix, "loop": loop}

   596	def audit(graph):
   597	    n = graph["n"]
   598	    start = graph["start"]
   599	    out = graph["out"]
   600	    rev = graph["rev"]
   601	    safe_nodes = graph["safe_nodes"]
   602	    done_nodes = graph["done_nodes"]
   603	
   604	    # Safety is unrestricted reachability, including paths through done and
   605	    # unsafe states.  Keep the first BFS unsafe witness.
   606	    parent, parent_edge = reachable_parents(start, out)
   607	    unsafe = None
   608	    for v in range(n):
   609	        if parent[v] != -2 and not safe_nodes[v]:
   610	            unsafe = v
   611	            break
   612	    is_safe = unsafe is None
   613	    safety = None if is_safe else {"prefix": reconstruct(unsafe, start, parent, parent_edge)}
   614	
   615	    # A done initial state already satisfies <>Done on every path.
   616	    if done_nodes[start]:
   617	        return {"safe": is_safe, "safety": safety, "terminates": True, "liveness": None}
   618	
   619	    # Counterexample reachability may not pass through a done state.
   620	    lp, le = reachable_parents(start, out, done_nodes)
   621	    live_vertices = [v for v in range(n) if lp[v] != -2]
   622	    fairness = graph["fairness"]
   623	    fcount = len(fairness)
   624	    all_fair = (1 << fcount) - 1
   625	    fair_bits = [0] * len(graph["names"])
   626	    weak_mask = 0
   627	    strong_mask = 0
   628	    for bit_no, (aid, mode) in enumerate(fairness):
   629	        bit = 1 << bit_no
   630	        fair_bits[aid] = bit
   631	        if mode == "weak":
   632	            weak_mask |= bit
   633	        else:
   634	            strong_mask |= bit
   635	    enabled = [0] * n
   636	    for v in range(n):
   637	        mask = 0
   638	        for _t, a, _eid in out[v]:
   639	            mask |= fair_bits[a]
   640	        enabled[v] = mask
   641	
   642	    # A stutter-only cycle is fair exactly when no declared action is enabled
   643	    # at its sole state.  This also handles graphs with no explicit edges.
   644	    if all_fair:
   645	        for v in live_vertices:
   646	            if enabled[v] == 0:
   647	                return {"safe": is_safe, "safety": safety, "terminates": False,
   648	                        "liveness": {"prefix": reconstruct(v, start, lp, le), "loop": [-1]}}
   649	    else:
   650	        v = live_vertices[0]
   651	        return {"safe": is_safe, "safety": safety, "terminates": False,
   652	                "liveness": {"prefix": reconstruct(v, start, lp, le), "loop": [-1]}}
   653	
   654	    # Fair-cycle search.  Weak fairness is a generalized Buechi condition:
   655	    # each weak action needs an internal occurrence or a disabled state.  For
   656	    # strong fairness, if an SCC has an enabled state but no internal
   657	    # occurrence, every fair cycle in it must avoid all those enabled states.
   658	    # Removing them and recomputing SCCs is the standard exact Streett SCC
   659	    # refinement; it deliberately does not use enabledness from the pruned
   660	    # graph.
   661	    work = strongly_connected(live_vertices, out, rev, enabled, fair_bits, all_fair)
   662	    while work:
   663	        comp = work.pop()
   664	        vs, edge_mask, enabled_or, disabled_mask = comp
   665	        if weak_mask & ~(edge_mask | disabled_mask):
   666	            continue
   667	        bad = strong_mask & enabled_or & ~edge_mask
   668	        if bad:
   669	            bit = bad & -bad
   670	            remaining = [v for v in vs if not (enabled[v] & bit)]
   671	            if remaining:
   672	                work.extend(strongly_connected(remaining, out, rev, enabled,
   673	                                                fair_bits, all_fair))
   674	            continue
   675	        witness = fair_witness(comp, out, rev, enabled, fair_bits, weak_mask,
   676	                               strong_mask, all_fair, lp, le, start)
   677	        return {"safe": is_safe, "safety": safety, "terminates": False,
   678	                "liveness": witness}
   679	
   680	    return {"safe": is_safe, "safety": safety, "terminates": True, "liveness": None}

   684	    return "{" + ",".join(str(x) for x in items) + "}"

   687	def export_graph(graph):
   688	    names = graph["names"]
   689	    aids = graph["action_ids"]
   690	    # String literals need no escaping: action names are ASCII alphanumeric
   691	    # and underscores by schema.
   692	    action_tuple = "<<" + ",".join('"' + a + '"' for a in names) + ">>"
   693	    triples = ["<<%d,%d,%d>>" % (s, a + 1, t) for s, a, t in graph["edges"]]
   694	    wf = []
   695	    sf = []
   696	    for aid, mode in graph["fairness"]:
   697	        (wf if mode == "weak" else sf).append(aid + 1)
   698	    safe = [i for i, yes in enumerate(graph["safe_nodes"]) if yes]
   699	    done = [i for i, yes in enumerate(graph["done_nodes"]) if yes]
   700	    lines = [
   701	        "---- MODULE ModelData ----",
   702	        "EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets",
   703	        "Nodes == 0..%d" % (graph["n"] - 1),
   704	        "Initial == %d" % graph["start"],
   705	        "Edges == " + tla_set(triples),
   706	        "ActionNames == " + action_tuple,
   707	        "WFIds == " + tla_set(wf),
   708	        "SFIds == " + tla_set(sf),
   709	        "SafeNodes == " + tla_set(safe),
   710	        "DoneNodes == " + tla_set(done),
   711	        "====",
   712	    ]
   713	    module = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
   714	    config = "SPECIFICATION Spec\nINVARIANT Safety\nPROPERTY Termination\nCHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE\n"
   715	    return {"module": module, "config": config}

   718	def handle(obj):
   719	    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
   720	        schema()
   721	    if "op" not in obj or "inputs" not in obj:
   722	        schema()
   723	    op = obj["op"]
   724	    if not isinstance(op, str):
   725	        schema()
   726	    if op == "replay":
   727	        return replay(obj)
   728	    if op == "audit" or op == "export":
   729	        graph = validate_graph(obj)
   730	        if op == "audit":
   731	            return audit(graph)
   732	        return export_graph(graph)
   733	    schema()

   736	def object_pairs(pairs):
   737	    ans = {}
   738	    for k, v in pairs:
   739	        if k in ans:
   740	            raise BadJSON()
   741	        ans[k] = v
   742	    return ans

   746	    raise BadJSON()

   749	def process_line(raw):
   750	    # sys.stdin.buffer iteration includes the LF, but no other line ending is
   751	    # removed before enforcing the 32 MiB line bound.
   752	    content = raw[:-1] if raw.endswith(b"\n") else raw
   753	    if len(content) > 32 * 1024 * 1024:
   754	        return {"error": "E_LIMIT"}
   755	    try:
   756	        text = content.decode("utf-8", "strict")
   757	        obj = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=object_pairs,
   758	                         parse_constant=bad_constant)
   759	    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, BadJSON, RecursionError, ValueError):
   760	        return {"error": "E_JSON"}
   761	    try:
   762	        return handle(obj)
   763	    except Failure as exc:
   764	        return {"error": exc.code}
   765	    except Exception:
   766	        # Malformed input must never produce a traceback on stdout.  All
   767	        # expected data-dependent failures are Failure instances above.
   768	        return {"error": "E_SCHEMA"}

   771	def main():
   772	    # Valid numeric fields are small, but JSON itself can contain a long
   773	    # integer token.  Let the normal field range checks classify it rather
   774	    # than leaking Python's implementation digit-limit exception.
   775	    try:
   776	        sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0)
   777	    except AttributeError:
   778	        pass
   779	    output = sys.stdout.buffer
   780	    for raw in sys.stdin.buffer:
   781	        ans = process_line(raw)
   782	        text = json.dumps(ans, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"))
   783	        output.write(text.encode("utf-8"))
   784	        output.write(b"\n")
   785	
   786	
   787	if __name__ == "__main__":
   788	    main()
